audience: marketing and comms teams that monitor brand mentions and competitors in Mention

useCases.text: List the alerts of the account, then list the mentions one alert found, newest first.

useCases.title: Read one mention and its task
useCases.text: Get one mention with its full details, then read a task on it and the teammate it is assigned to.

useCases.title: Chart mention volume over time
